另开一个命令行窗口和它对话，可以和 StudyHub 左右并排（Win + ←: Opens a command-line window of its own to chat with it; snap it beside StudyHub with Win + ← / →. It can read and change the files in your library directly, and StudyHub does not check those changes.

想接着用 DSH 插件里的学习库，选那个工作区文件夹就行；两边通过文件锁共用同一: To go on with a library from the DSH plugin, pick that workspace folder; both apps share the same materials and decks through file locks. If you run both at once, avoid batch writes in both at the same time.
你选的「{0}」里已有 DSH 插件的学习库，这里直接使用它（其中的 .dsh-: The folder you picked, "{0}", already holds a library from the DSH plugin, so StudyHub uses that one (the .dsh-study folder inside it); your decks and records are all there.
StudyHub 桌面版暂不支持应用内自动覆盖安装。按下面 3 步升级到新版本，: StudyHub Desktop does not overwrite itself in-app yet. Follow these 3 steps to upgrade; your library, model config and settings stay intact:
关闭 StudyHub 桌面版窗口，确保后台任务已停下（已完成的部分会保留）。: Close the StudyHub Desktop window so background tasks stop cleanly (completed progress is kept).
运行新版 .msi 安装程序覆盖安装，或将便携版 .zip 解压到固定目录后启动: Run the new .msi installer to upgrade in place, or extract the portable .zip to a stable folder and launch StudyHub.exe.
安全提示：开源桌面版暂未购买商业代码签名证书。若 Windows SmartSc: Security note: the open-source Desktop build is currently unsigned. If Windows SmartScreen warns you, verify SHA256SUMS from GitHub Releases first, then select More info -> Run anyway.

各处提示和引导什么时候出现: When each tip and guide appears
报问题时点「复制诊断信息」，把文字贴给开发者；点「看看会复制什么」可以先读一遍。: When reporting a problem, select Copy diagnostic info and paste the text for the developer; select See what will be copied to read it first. It includes only the version, UI language, page, error type, built-in error phrase, failing function name, job kind and status, counts of materials/decks/questions, whether experimental features are on, and this session's page-switch speed, stall count and snapshot timings (kept in memory only); other error text is replaced with its character count.
